defs.def: to restore sth that is broken, damaged or torn to good condition 修理；修补；修缮

ex.s: Creative Workshops: learn basic repairs and artistic redesign of old furniture, while sharing knowledge and ideas with fellow volunteers,
ex.t: 社会与环境行动：通过创造力和合作帮助应对社会和环境挑战。

ex.s: Damages of scentscapes can be artificially repaired.
ex.t: 缺失植物的气味在大气中被保存下来。

ex.s: Nature can repair itself.
ex.t: 大自然可以自我修复。

ex.s: It is calculated that European railways alone spend approximately 20 billion euros a year on maintenance, including sending maintenance staff, often at night, to inspect and repair the rail infrastructure.
ex.t: 这可能是危险的工作，如果有无人机协助工作人员就可以避免这种危险。

ex.s: Inspection and repair.
ex.t: 基础设施的建设。

ex.s: By the end of 2020, Pruitt had repaired more than 140 for donation or to be 28 to their owners.
ex.t: 到2020年底普鲁特已经修理了140多辆用于捐赠或   28   归还给车主。

ex.s: Learn to repair cars.
ex.t: 拒绝这份工作邀请。

ex.t: A．was repairedB．is repaired

ex.t: C．正在被修理 D．已被修理

ex.s: It will be repaired.
ex.t: 它会被修缮。

ex.s: One of his friends had stopped to make a bicycle repair, but they had encouraged Mac to carry on, and they would catch up with him soon.
ex.t: 他的一个朋友停下来修自行车，但他们鼓励麦克继续前进，说很快就会赶上他。

ex.s: Approached in this way, your friendship will soon be repaired.
ex.t: 以这种方式处理，你们的友谊很快就会修复。

ex.s: But for quite some time, he and his student Qi Haonan used to be the only two people repairing timepieces in the Palace Museum.
ex.t: 但在相当长一段时间里，他和他的学生亓昊楠曾经是故宫博物院里仅有的两位钟表修复师。

ex.s: But, through their painstaking efforts, Mr Wang and his students do more than repair the clocks — they bring them back to life.
ex.t: 但是，通过他们艰苦的努力，王先生和他的学生们做的不仅仅是修复钟表——他们让它们重获了新生。

ex.s: The only sound to break the silence in Wang Jin’s workshop is the chiming melody of the repaired and polished clocks.
ex.t: 在王津的工作室里，打破寂静的唯一声音是那些被修复和打磨过的钟发出的报时旋律。

ex.s: Even if every clock in the Palace Museum were restored, there would still be work to do, because restoration would probably need to begin again on the clocks that were repaired long ago.
ex.t: 即使故宫博物院里的每一座钟都被修复了，仍然有工作要做，因为很久以前修复过的钟很可能又需要重新开始修复了。

ex.s: But Inglis ended up buying hundreds of them himself, with the idea of repairing and selling them.
ex.t: 但英格利斯最终自己买下了数百个，打算修理后出售。

ex.s: LoveFone, a company that advocates repairing cellphones rather than abandoning them, opened a mini workshop in a London phone box in 2016.
ex.t: 倡导修理而非丢弃手机的LoveFone公司，于2016年在伦敦一个电话亭里开了一家迷你工坊。

ex.s: He is most probably repairing the desk.
ex.t: 如果这位女士参加面试，她可以得到这份工作。

ex.s: It’s also our job to support adults who need help repairing incomplete life cycles.
ex.t: 支持那些需要帮助以修复不完整生命周期的成年人，也是我们的职责。

defs.def: to say or do sth in order to improve a bad or unpleasant situation 补救；纠正；弥补

ex.s: Provide tips on repairing their cars.
ex.t: 提供修车建议。

ex.s: They didn’t think much of it when they saw two cyclists repairing their bike on the side of the road.
ex.t: 他们看到路边有两个骑自行车的人在修车时并没有太在意。
